verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਹਰਿ ਅਹਾਰ ਮਾਸ ਸੁਰਹੀ ਅਧਾਰ ਘਾਸ ਮਧੁਪ ਕਮਲ ਬਾਸ ਲੇਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kehar ahaar maas surahee adhaar ghaas madhup kamal baas let sukh maanahee ||

en.bdb: Just as meat is the food of a lion, grass-that of a cow, while a bumble bee feels happy with the fragrance of a lotus flower. Just as a fish likes living in water, a child has support of milk for sustenance and cold breeze is considered friend of a snake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਨੀਰ ਬਾਲਕ ਅਧਾਰ ਖੀਰ ਸਰਪਹ ਸਖਾ ਸਮੀਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: meeneh nivaas neer baalak adhaar kheer sarapeh sakhaa sameer jeevan kai jaanahee ||

en.bdb: Just a ruddy sheldrake loves the moon, a peacock is enamored by the black clouds while the rain-bird is always craving for the Swati drop.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਘਨਹਰ ਘਟਾ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dheh chaahai chakor ghanahar ghaTaa mor chaatirak boo(n)dhan savaiaa(n)t dharat dhiaan hee ||

en.bdb: Just as a scholar indulges in discourse and exposition while a worldly person is involved in worldly affairs, just as the whole world is immersed in the love of mammon (maya),

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਲੋਕਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਕਾਚਾਰ  ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀ ॥੫੯੯॥
verses.translit_en: pa(n)ddit bedh beechaar lokan mai lokaachaar  maiaa moh mai sa(n)saar giaan gur giaan hee ||599||

en.bdb: Similarly, a Guru-conscious and Guru aware person remains engrossed in the elixir-like name of the Lord blessed by the True Guru. (Practicing of Naam becomes then his life's support).  (599)
